title: BuildStoreError manual Display/From instead of thiserror — inconsistent with rest of crate
description: BuildStoreError in reader/src/store/server_stores.rs manually implements std::fmt::Display and From<CredentialStoreError>. The rest of the auth crate uses thiserror (#[derive(thiserror::Error)]). The manual implementation produces the same result but requires 11 lines where #[derive(thiserror::Error)] + two #[error] attributes would require 6. More importantly, when a reviewer or contributor adds a new BuildStoreError variant they will write thiserror-style attributes (consistent with CredentialStoreError) but this type requires them to hand-write a match arm in the Display impl — a maintenance trap.
